name: the Gate Cairn
descriptionSeed: The Ashwardens keep their gate where they keep everything that crosses from one state to another: outside, tended, with a lamp. What comes through walks the cairn-path in, slowly, past the dead, and by the time it reaches the terraces the wardens know what it is. Nobody has ever been turned away; a few have turned back.
appearance: Out on the heath at the end of a cairn-row, a low stone ring round the gate with a warden's hut and a lamp that never goes out. A grey path of flat stones leads the two miles in to Cairnhold between the rows.
encounterFlavor: A warden asking your name and writing it on a slate she will wipe tonight; a mourner waiting at the arch for someone who is not coming through; the lamp guttering once, for no reason, when a stranger steps out.
